answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Signed ski-pass usage with lift scans. It requires lift scans across three seasons at one resort, so the sable of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Honest agents barely notice the check, because lift scans across three seasons at one resort is something they already have; the pulse falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The ocean is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
